adopt:
pip install "awdk[memory]"
# The toolpack ships inside awdk (adk/toolpacks/deep_research) and registers
# its ten dr_* tools automatically when loaded by awdk or AitherOS:
adk pack show deep-research
adk chat --pack deep_research
description:
Kind: pack

What it does
Multi-engine keyless web research and cited report writing: multi-angle web sweeps, cached page extraction, same-domain mirroring, a citable findings knowledge graph, and Markdown/PDF/DOCX report generation (registered in the runtime with dr_* prefixes).

Runtime
awdk>=3.8.0 with extras: memory

Tools
  deep_research
  web_search
  fetch_url
  mirror_website
  save_finding
  recall
  knowledge_graph
  generate_markdown
  generate_pdf
  generate_docx
synopsis: Multi-engine keyless web research and cited report writing: multi-angle web sweeps, cached page extraction, same-domain mirroring, a citable findings knowledge graph, and Markdown/PDF/DOCX report generation (registered in the runtime with dr_* prefixes).
